name: Pete
mentions: Pete, the colored cook, had a narrow escape at the depot last evening. As the train was pulling out he attempted to jump on, but making a miscue he fell between the platform…

…e (or half a dozen) to molest or make him afraid. A new combination billard table will soon grace the saloon. Pete still presides over the culinary department with his usual grace and urbanity and says he is bound to "fill up de boys" if he has to go dry to do it. Johnny Chute dishes…
